hooks.command: bash -c 'flutter analyze; exit_code=$?; if [ $exit_code -eq 1 ]; then exit 2; fi; exit $exit_code'

bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path); case "$FILE" in lib/services/*) TEST_DIR="test/services/" ;; lib/database/*) TEST_DIR="test/database/" ;; lib/screens/*) TEST_DIR="test/screens/" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; echo "[hook] running flutter test $TEST_DIR"; flutter test "$TEST_DIR" 2>&1; exit_code=$?; if [ $exit_code -eq 1 ]; then exit 2; fi; exit $exit_code'
